findings.rationale: Repaired 3.1: frame height H = max(2+info+c, 2c+1), the smallest height with ctrlCap(H) >= c; H <= M always since c <= ctrlCap(M); H=5 c=2 gives info 1.
Same fold as af8306d4: print-only fallback removed.
Folded 4/5/7: one 8-cell matrix used by mocks, screenshots and U5.

Repaired 3.1: explicit order (ctrlCap(M) to page, page fits info, frame sets H); non-ladder collapse runs before the assertion; info-press check records for decide during U1 and throws from U2 when KNOWN empties.
Repaired 3.3: state table for note input, o overflow (L3/L4 only) and submit preview, each within the tier row count and with required press keys; L5 has no inline states.

Repaired 3.3/3.4: selector press is key:card only when the selector has >1 row, else p/n (covers C mode); maxRows<10 override removed so L3 is reachable; single L5 definition with every segment pressable.

Repaired 4: rule table with M, ctrlCap, column mode, tier and control rows for all 8 cells is the reference; rules win over mocks; wrong H=13 mock removed; frame no longer truncates (page fits info per 3.2).

Repaired 3.6: view carries a per-invocation nonce, live pane switches only on a new nonce so manual tab changes stick; no self-chosen fallback, a failed U0 probe stops U4 and goes to PM; D4 unchanged.
Folded 5: cursor = min(cursor, count-1); count 0 gives cursor 0 and the empty state.
